---
name: build-index
description: Generate src/course.js (topics, exam weights, page order, past exams) from content/00-index.md. Use when the user adds or updates 00-index.md, or says "/build-index".
---

# Build the course index

1. `git switch main && git pull --ff-only`. The working tree must be clean apart from content/ files the user just added.
2. Read `content/00-index.md`. Its YAML frontmatter is the source of truth (format: `docs/step1-prompt.md`).
3. Write `src/course.js`:
   ```js
   // Generated by /build-index from content/00-index.md — regenerate, don't hand-edit.
   export default {
     name: '<name>',
     topics: [{ id, title, weight, weightNote, summary, pages: [{ slug, title }] }],
     pastExams: [{ id, label, note }],
   }
   ```
   Keep the order exactly as in the file. Leave out `color` so the topic palette is used (unless the user asks for specific colors).
4. Cross-check: list slugs that are in the index but have no `content/*.md`, and content files missing from the index. Report them; don't invent entries.
5. Update the **Topics** table in `README.md` (slug · title · topic · weight).
6. `npm run lint && npm run build`, then `scripts/screenshot.sh ''`. Look at the index.
7. Commit straight to `main` (`git add content/ src/course.js README.md`, message `chore(index): build course map from 00-index.md`) and push. This is approved infra; only pages go through PRs.
No co-author trailers.
